content.body: First RAF Raid! The day after the declaration of war was announced, the RAF, using Wellington and Blenheim bombers, attacked the German naval ports of Wilhelmshaven and Brunsbuttel. This almost ended in near disaster! Ten bombers returned to base after failing to locate their target. Seven were lost to German anti-air batteries. Three of the planes began attack runs on three British warships until they recognized their error and returned to base. Eight of the original flight found their target and dropped their payload on the Scheer and Hipper and the cruiser Emden.
